items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, and Audubon tea room Al Lowberry on bass, who I hardly remember.

ctx.x: I think that's one of the first jobs I've booked over here on your left, Dick.
Yeah, and Audubon tea room Al Lowberry on bass, who I hardly remember. Oh yeah, and I see the first group you played with under the title of Red Hot Castillo? What's his name?
Yeah, he played at the lake, you know, for the girl boys mostly. He tried to be a good Dixie drummer.
